name: Compile tract profiles to summary structure
summary: Compiles the per-tract profile csv files of one subject's tractprofile output into a single long-format csv (subject, tract, node, mean of each measure) with pandas, for group analysis and machine learning.
description: Reads every *_profiles.csv in the tractprofile directory, keeps the *_mean columns, and writes output_FiberStats.csv with one row per tract and node and one column per diffusion measure, labelled with the subject ID from the input metadata. Use it to turn tract profiles into a tidy table; the README mentions tracts.csv but the code writes output_FiberStats.csv.

inputs.description: The path to the top directory containing the tract profile .csv files

outputs.description: The output is a combined version of the inputted .csvs file into a single .csv file analyses

failure_modes.message: stats computations failed somewhere. please check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check that the profiles directory contains *_profiles.csv files with *_mean columns.
